summary: Readiness review for iteration `customer-feedback-form` succeeded after human clarification. The prerequisite `feedback-request-batch-upload` is complete and approved: Prisma has `FeedbackBatch` and `Feedback` models, feedback rows store `productName`, `purchaseDate`, unique `linkIdentifier`, nullable `rating`, nullable `feedbackMessage`, and `submittedAt`; the request email contract already links to `/feedback/{linkIdentifier}`. The remaining public form scope is now defined: feedback links remain valid for 30 days, and repeat visits after submission should show the existing feedback. Current source has no public `/feedback` route yet and no customer feedback requirements artifact yet, but those are expected delivery/analysis work, not readiness blockers now that the missing product rules are resolved. Fresh approved checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `npm.cmd run lint`, and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\feedback-request-batch-upload-source.test.mjs` with 22/22 passing. Browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email delivery were not run per task constraints.
